description: Get an ETF's stored portfolio holdings, largest position first: a US fund's latest SEC Form NPORT-P report (coverage full, partial, or unknown when counts are missing or inconsistent), or, for a fund on another exchange named MIC:TICKER, the fund sponsor's published portfolio file as of its stated date, every row as filed with its weight. Use offset to continue through broad portfolios.

offset.description: Number of ranked holdings to skip (default 0).
